how: We read the website of every Detroit wedding videographer listed on Lazo (105 listings, 83 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a photo booth rental, an Upper Peninsula studio with a Pinckney listing, Windsor-side filmmakers, and photographers who do not offer film. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
If the ceremony is in a church and the reception is across town in January, how do you cover the drive and the early dark?

picks.name: Mike Staff Productions
picks.blurb: Mike Staff launched his Troy company in 1996 to simplify wedding planning and says it has since helped more than 25,000 couples. DJ, photography and videography come from one coordinated team, and you pick your own photographer by browsing profiles on the site.

picks.name: Captured 4 Life Photography & Cinematography
picks.blurb: Sam studied video production and photography and, with his wife, started Captured 4 Life in 2005 doing sports photography before the business grew into Sam Klos Wedding Films, cinematic wedding videos around Allen Park. Packages list drone footage, weather and location permitting, and professional audio for the ceremony and toasts.

picks.name: Elite Wedding Co.
picks.blurb: Since 1991, Elite Wedding Co. in Warren has offered wedding photography, DJ services, cinematic videography, accent lighting and photo booths under one roof, with the slogan One Day One Love One Company. The pitch is a single team coordinating all of it.

picks.name: Sunflow Media Production LLC
picks.blurb: Sunflow Media is a wedding videographer, photographer, live-stream crew and photo booth company in one, with nineteen years of professional imaging and lighting, booked on a single contract for a single day. Where most couples hire four vendors, it staffs all of it from one roster. Ann Arbor, Metro Detroit and Southeast Michigan.

picks.name: Bee's Video Productions
picks.blurb: Handcrafted wedding films that capture how the day feels, the unexpected moments and everything in between, is how Bee's Video in Shelby Township describes its work. It reserves only a limited number of weddings each year so it can focus on each couple.

picks.name: Timeless Moments Studio | Wedding Photography Detroit
picks.blurb: Photo and film from one Detroit studio: Rami Ajo films luxury weddings across Michigan and worldwide alongside his photography. His approach, in his words, is close, warm and without a rush, paying attention to what lives in between, and the site leads with words from past couples.

picks.name: BN Production
picks.blurb: Based in Sterling Heights and serving couples across the globe, BN Production specializes in high-end wedding photography and videography it describes as timeless elegance with modern artistry. A team of visual storytellers rather than a single shooter, focused on authenticity, emotion and detail.

picks.name: Bioscope Photography & Cinematography
picks.blurb: Bioscope is a Michigan photography and videography company in Warren that also lists decor and DJ among its services. It has served clients as far as Florida, New Jersey, New York, Canada and Georgia, and promises a professional, relaxed manner.

picks.name: JD Entertainment, LLC
picks.blurb: John DeVergilio created JD Entertainment in 1998 and has built separate DJ, photography and videography departments with a hand-picked team. Bundling services is encouraged on the site, and corporate events are a second line of work. Clinton Township.

picks.name: Michaels Entertainment
picks.blurb: Michaels Entertainment in Troy fields DJs, filmmakers and photographers under one roof and lets you browse each team member's profile, watch them in action and choose the one who fits. Wedding packages are described as tailored rather than fixed.

picks.name: White Lotus Production LLC
picks.blurb: Chris founded White Lotus Production and brings over 28 years in entertainment as a musician, DJ, photographer and videographer, among a long list of other hats that includes ordained minister. The Redford Township company offers DJs, photo booths, lighting, videography and live musicians for weddings.
